overview.description: The Infrastructure Capital Nasdaq Option Income ETF (QVOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively selects equity securities and option investments linked to the Nasdaq Composite Index. It utilizes blended option strategies to generate high monthly income from option premiums and equity dividends QVOL was launched on May 12, 2026 and is issued by InfraCap.
